title_en: Doctors and Pharmacies (10/20): A Night in the ER
note_en: Chinese can stack a 把 phrase with a direction: 能把病人从危险中救回来 "being able to bring a patient back from danger." The object (病人) moves before the verb, the starting point is marked with 从…中, and the result comes at the end with 回来 ("back"); English keeps the order verb, object, "back from."
